Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5260813. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5260813. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID.
